about: I was born in Flekkefjord, Norway, moved to Colorado after high school, and served eight years in the US Army as a forward observer, personal security specialist and geospatial intelligence analyst, including a deployment to Afghanistan.

After the Army I spent a decade in GIS marketing and agency search, leading AEO and technical SEO for enterprise health systems. Today I build agentic AI tools as an AI Search Strategist at Whole Whale and take on independent AI and search projects.
